title: Ensure 'Interactive logon: Do not display last user name' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Interactive logon: Do not display last user name to 'Enabled'
reason: If the last user's name is displayed on the screen, an attacker can collect this information and use it to attempt to guess the password.

title: Ensure 'Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit' is set to '900 or fewer seconds, but not 0'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit to '900 or fewer seconds, but not 0'
reason: If a user forgets to lock their computer, an attacker could access the system. Setting this timeout automatically locks the session.

title: Ensure 'Interactive logon: Require Domain Controller authentication to unlock workstation' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Local Policies\Security Options\Interactive logon: Require Domain Controller authentication to unlock workstation to 'Enabled'
reason: Requires the computer to re-authenticate with the domain controller when unlocking, ensuring that recently disabled or modified accounts cannot unlock the machine using cached credentials.
